usedFor: Speak AI analyzes audio, video and text, and Calendly turns a finished analysis into a link via “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “Media Analyzed” in Speak AI, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: Once a recording has been analyzed, the action prepares a link for booking the conversation that follows.

watchOut: “New Events Created” in Speak AI is polling, while “Media Analyzed” is pushed, so pick the second when timing matters.
